notes.title: Season 14 Energy and Points System Update
notes.notes:
With the launch of Season 14 we are changing up the way the Racer Energy and Streamer Points systems work. Moving forward we are working to have the Marbles XP and Point system coincide along with the new changes Twitch has been making for viewers and streamers to have better alignment with our Marbles Racers and Streamers.

Below is a breakdown of how the new Season 14 system will work:

Racer System
 Start each day 3am EST (12am PST) Racers will reset to  have 50 Energy.
 1 Energy Spent per race participated in (Energy only spent on race completion)
 Earn Energy from completing bonus tiers in unique streams (meaning 5, 10, 20, etc in one individuals stream.)
    -Tier 1 = 5 total Races -> 5 Energy returned
    -Tier 2 = 10 total Races -> 6 Energy returned
    -Tier 3 = 20 total Races -> 12 Energy returned
    -Tier 4 = 40 total Races -> 20 Energy returned
    -Tier 5 = 60 total Races -> 20 Energy returned
    -Tier 6 = 100 total Races -> 40 Energy returned
0 Energy = 0 Season points distributed (Does effect Grand Prix, Does NOT effect local leaderboards)https://i.ibb.co/7V2kTf3/Point-system.png

Streamer System
 1 Bonus bonus races awarded per hour caps at 120
 Earn 2x XP for Bonus Races (1 Bonus race spent per race)
 Max Bonus XP for time in race 3 Mins (reduced from 6 Min)
 Earn Bonus XP for completing viewer tiers. Tier = XP rewarded
https://i.ibb.co/LnPtJjP/Point-system2.png
If you have any questions about this new system please post it below.

If there are any updates to this system from now until actual launch this entry will be updated!

NOTE: This implementation will only effect racers and streamers who play marbles at a global competitive level.

Season 14 is going to be unlike any other, it also marks the final update of 2019 and this decade!!!
